description: A 'settings import' request where the legacy export lacks SSO, retention and custom-field keys that customers already set, and there is no undo; a correct answer surfaces the replace-vs-merge choice with merge as the recommended default and writes acceptance criteria that preserve unspecified settings.

product-manager.task: Turn the request in `{fixture}/request.md` into acceptance criteria. Supporting material: `{fixture}/src/settings/model.py`, `{fixture}/legacy-export-sample.json`, and `{fixture}/notes.md`. Include any questions you need answered before engineering starts. You cannot write files in this run, so put your complete answer in your final message.

rubricPoints.requirement: Raises whether an import replaces all existing settings or merges with them, and recommends merge (keep existing values for keys absent from the file) as the default.
Names at least one concrete setting that a replace would wipe because the legacy export lacks it: SSO enforcement, retention days, or custom fields.
Gives acceptance criteria that are observable and testable, including one stating that a setting absent from the imported file keeps its prior value.
Includes a criterion for a malformed or invalid settings file (for example, rejected with an error and no settings changed).
